baseline.audit_name: SST chiral Kelvin full falsification battery

convergence.audit_name: SST chiral Kelvin v0.1.3.1 convergence campaign
convergence.epistemic_status: near-degenerate subspace convergence hardening; trefoil remains frozen geometry
convergence.rule: Physical interpretation requires numerical trackability, RESOLVED core sampling, RESOLVED wavelength sampling, and an established relative equilibrium.

fraction_semantics.numerical_tracking_fraction_all: Trackable clusters divided by all matched clusters.
fraction_semantics.resolved_trackable_fraction: Trackable clusters divided only by clusters satisfying both core and wavelength resolution at both grids.
fraction_semantics.physical_trackable_fraction: Trackable clusters divided only by resolved clusters with an established relative-equilibrium interpretation.

interpretation_gate: Implementation validity, numerical trackability, core resolution and relative-equilibrium validity are independent gates.

conclusions.title: Analytic Jacobian implementation
conclusions.conclusion: The analytic Frechet/Jacobian action agrees with finite-difference differentiation at approximately 1e-10 relative error in the validated baseline.

conclusions.title: Python/native parity
conclusions.conclusion: The validated Python and C++/pybind implementations agree to approximately machine precision for the baseline observables.

conclusions.title: Circulation reversal symmetry
conclusions.conclusion: The implemented frozen-geometry dynamical operator respects the expected circulation-reversal symmetry.

conclusions.title: Four-state scalar energy degeneracy
conclusions.conclusion: Within the isotropic finite-core Euler/Biot-Savart model, scalar kinetic energy cannot split the four (handedness, circulation) states.

conclusions.title: Scalar energy converges faster than spectrum
conclusions.conclusion: Scalar-energy convergence is not a sufficient proxy for eigenspectral convergence.

conclusions.title: Low-resolution trefoil spectrum is not converged
conclusions.conclusion: The frozen trefoil spectrum at the tested low resolutions cannot be promoted to a converged physical SST spectrum.

conclusions.title: Circularity remains useful
conclusions.conclusion: Circularity behaves coherently as a mode diagnostic, but circularity convergence alone does not establish frequency convergence.

conclusions.title: Matcher self-consistency
conclusions.conclusion: The v0.1.2 matcher self-test gives essentially unity subspace overlap and Fourier-fingerprint similarity.

conclusions.title: Near-degenerate rotation is not the sole bottleneck
conclusions.conclusion: Near-degenerate eigenspace rotation explains only part of the observed convergence failure. Spatial/core and wavelength resolution increasingly appear to dominate the remaining frequency drift.

conclusions.title: N <= 96 is not core resolved
conclusions.conclusion: None of the tested N <= 96 grids satisfy the adopted eta_a <= 0.5 core-resolution gate.

conclusions.title: First core-resolved regime is approximately N=256
conclusions.conclusion: Observed eta_a scaling indicates that N around 256 is an appropriate first core-resolved campaign target.

conclusions.title: Wavelength resolution is an independent gate
conclusions.conclusion: Mode frequency convergence requires a wavelength sampling criterion in addition to core resolution.

conclusions.title: Circularity often converges faster than frequency
conclusions.conclusion: Several matched branches preserve overlap, Fourier identity, and circularity while omega remains substantially resolution dependent.

conclusions.title: Conditioning is not the main high-C drift source
conclusions.conclusion: Many high-circularity modes have eigenvalue condition numbers near unity, so strong non-normal sensitivity does not explain their dominant frequency drift.

conclusions.title: Fixed m_max=24 fingerprint ceiling is inadequate
conclusions.conclusion: The m=24 cap aliases multiple high-frequency branches and must be replaced by a resolution-dependent Nyquist-safe range.

conclusions.title: Core-resolution threshold reached
conclusions.conclusion: For core_factor=1, the N=256,320,384 campaign places both ring and frozen trefoil inside the adopted eta_a <= 0.5 core-resolution regime.

conclusions.title: Resolved-grid numerical mode tracking established
conclusions.conclusion: Trefoil numerically-trackable fractions reach about 88.27 percent for N=256->320 and 95.35 percent for N=320->384.

conclusions.title: Multiple three-resolution mode chains converge
conclusions.conclusion: Multiple frozen-trefoil branches can be followed through N=256->320->384 with high overlap, stable Fourier identity, stable circularity and decreasing frequency drift.

conclusions.title: Frozen geometry remains non-physical
conclusions.conclusion: Numerical convergence of a frozen-trefoil eigenbranch does not establish a physical SST normal mode. A true relative equilibrium and co-moving operator remain required.

conclusions.title: Previous spectral failure was predominantly resolution driven
conclusions.conclusion: The transition from poor low-resolution tracking to greater than 88 percent and then 95 percent tracking on the resolved ladder strongly supports finite discretization/resolution as the dominant earlier bottleneck.

conclusions.title: PPW predicts spectral convergence quality
conclusions.conclusion: The resolved campaign supports PPW as an independent wavelength-resolution diagnostic. Branches satisfying the adopted PPW >= 12 criterion show substantially improved spectral stability.

conclusions.title: Circularity is a stable candidate mode observable
conclusions.conclusion: Circularity remains stable across many resolved tracked branches. This establishes it as a robust numerical diagnostic, not yet as a physical SST quantum number.

conclusions.title: Physical Kelvin spectrum requires relative equilibrium
conclusions.conclusion: The next physics gate is an ideal-trefoil relative equilibrium with co-moving linearization and removal of rigid and tangential gauge directions.

conclusions_summary.rule: Machine-readable conclusion states do not automatically rewrite CONCLUSIONS.md.
